messages: #p308# has just completed her latest research and needs someone to deliver the report across the sea.
Deliver #p308#'s research report to #p323#, the sailor who voyages to and from Ossyria. You can find her at #m10002090#.
You delivered #p308#'s research report to #p323#. Now that I've come all this way... why not hop aboard the ship bound for Ossyria?
name: [Event] A New Adventure Awaits
